question.text: The number of solutions of the equation <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>θ</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>cos</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi></math> is equal to ______.

solution.text:
2θ-cos2θ+2=0

⇒ 2θ+2=cos2θ

As per the graph drawn there is only one point of intersection, so only one solution of the given equation.
